T: See the dinner. Then eat it.
D: A paralysed marine links to a Na'vi body on Pandora and starts to change sides.
P: Serve the snacks when the forest lights up around Jake and Neytiri at night.
S: the forest glowing under Jake's feet
Dragon fruit, kiwifruit, pineapple and blueberries threaded onto skewers, drizzled with lime and honey, served on a dark board under low light.
Pork belly simmered in soy, ginger and star anise until soft, sliced, tucked into steamed bao buns with pickled cucumber, coriander and crushed peanuts.
Hometree lemongrass fish in banana leaf
the giant Hometree where the clan lives

Firm white fish rubbed with a paste of lemongrass, chilli, garlic and lime, wrapped in banana leaves and grilled, unwrapped at the table with nam jim. Blitz 2 lemongrass stalks, 2 red chillies, 3 garlic cloves, a knob of ginger, a handful of coriander, the zest of a lime and 1 tbsp fish sauce to a paste. Cut 600g ling fillets into 8 pieces and coat in the paste. Wrap each in a square of softened banana leaf and pin with a toothpick. Grill over medium heat for 10 minutes. Mix lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chilli for nam jim.
M: Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and smoked paprika, roasted low at 150C for 5 hours, pulled apart and served with flatbreads and a herb salad.
Ikran flight prawn and pumpkin curry

King prawns and pumpkin simmered in coconut milk with green curry paste, lime leaves and fish sauce, Thai basil folded through, with jasmine rice. Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste in 2 tbsp coconut cream for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add 400ml coconut milk, 200ml water, 4 torn lime leaves and 500g pumpkin in 2cm chunks and simmer 12 minutes until tender. Add 600g peeled green king prawns and simmer 3 minutes. Season with 2 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tsp palm sugar, then fold through Thai basil. Serve with 300g steamed jasmine rice.
W: Coconut tapioca pudding simmered 15 minutes, chilled, layered in glasses with mango and passionfruit, topped with toasted coconut.
K: the blue skin of the Na'vi
Coconut water, pineapple juice and a splash of blue curaçao or blue sports drink over ice, garnished with pineapple.

s.note: the forest glowing under Jake's feet
s.how: Cut a dragon fruit, 2 kiwifruit and a quarter pineapple into chunks and thread onto skewers with 125g blueberries. Drizzle with lime juice and honey and serve on a dark board under low light.
Simmer 600g pork belly in 125ml soy, sliced ginger, 2 star anise and water for 2 hours, then slice. Steam 12 bao buns and fill with pork, pickled cucumber, coriander and crushed peanuts.

m.how: Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Serve with 6 warm flatbreads and a salad of mint and parsley.

w.how: Simmer 100g tapioca pearls in 800ml coconut milk and 400ml water with 80g sugar for 15 minutes until clear. Chill. Layer in glasses with 2 diced mangoes and the pulp of 4 passionfruit, and top with toasted coconut.

d.note: the blue skin of the Na'vi
d.how: Fill four glasses with ice. Pour in 150ml coconut water and 150ml pineapple juice each, then a splash of blue curaçao for the adults. Garnish with a pineapple wedge.
